help.heading: Yadda ake amfani da lissafin girke-girke
help.intro: Lissafin yana mayar da girke-girken glaze, wato nauyin kayan aikin da kuke haɗawa, zuwa UMF (unity molecular formula) ɗinsa: oxide ɗin da glaze ke zama a cikin kiln (murhun gasa tukwane), an daidaita su ta yadda flux za su kai 1 gaba ɗaya. Yana sabuntawa yayin da kuke rubutu.

name.heading: Ba wa girke-girken suna
name.text: Ba shi suna. Kwanan wata da bayanai ba dole ba ne; bayanai wuri ne mai kyau na cone, yanayin wuta da yadda gwajin ya fito.

materials.heading: Ƙara kayan aiki
materials.text: A ƙarƙashin Ƙara kayan aiki, zaɓi Kayana (waɗanda kuka shigar a shafin Kayan aiki, kamar analysis ɗinku na wani feldspar) ko Na asali (jerin da aka gina a ciki). Rubuta wani ɓangare na suna a cikin tacewa don rage dogon jeri, sannan ku danna kaya don ƙara shi. Alamar rubutu tana zuwa adadinsa.

amounts.heading: Shigar da adadi
amounts.text: Yi amfani da kowane ma'auni: kashi, rabo ko giram. Daidaito kaɗai ne ke da muhimmanci ga sinadaran. Ginshiƙin kaso yana nuna kashin kowane kaya a cikin batch, kuma jimlar tana ƙarƙashin jerin.

unity.heading: Karanta UMF
unity.text: Yana gefen girke-girken (a ƙasansa a waya) kuma yana canjawa da kowane adadin da kuka rubuta:
unity.fluxes: Flux (R₂O da RO) suna kai 1.000 gaba ɗaya; su ne ke sa glaze ya narke.
unity.stabilizers: Masu daidaitawa (R₂O₃), galibi alumina, suna ƙarfafa narkewar don ta zauna a kan tukunya.
unity.glassFormers: Masu yin gilashi (RO₂), galibi silica, suna yin gilashin.
unity.ratio: Rabon silica da alumina yana nuna alamar fuskar glaze: rabo mafi girma yakan fi sheƙi, ƙarami yakan fi rashin sheƙi, ko da yake flux da gasawa ma suna da muhimmanci.
unity.problems: Idan ba a san wani kaya ba, ko wani adadi ba lamba ba ne, ko babu flux a cikin girke-girken, zai faɗi haka.

additives.heading: Ƙara masu launi da ƙarin kaya
additives.text: Waɗannan suna zuwa a saman tushe. Ana ajiye su tare da girke-girken amma ba sa cikin UMF. Zaɓi abin da kowane adadi yake ciki:
additives.percent: % na tushe: kashi na jimlar tushe, kamar yadda yawancin girke-girke ke ba da su: 2 na nufin 2% red iron oxide.
additives.parts: rabo: ma'auni ɗaya da na kayan aiki, kamar rabo 1 a kan tushe na flint 3 da dolomite 2.
additives.grams: giram: nauyi, a cikin batch ɗaya da kayan aiki.

scale.heading: Canja ma'auni idan kuna buƙata
scale.percent: Zuwa kashi: kayan suna kai 100 gaba ɗaya.
scale.parts: Zuwa rabo: mafi ƙanƙantar lambobi cikakku da suka dace, kamar flint 3 da dolomite 2; kayan da ba ya rabuwa daidai yana riƙe ainihin adadinsa, kamar 1.477.
scale.batch: Daidaita zuwa batch: shigar da nauyi, kamar 500 g, don samun giram ɗin da za a auna. Da nauyi a fam da oza (a ƙarƙashin Saituna a shafin asusunku), shigar da fam, kamar 12.5: adadin suna zama fam, kowanne ana nuna shi a fam da oza a ƙarƙashinsa.
scale.text: Kowane adadi yana canjawa a lokaci ɗaya, har zuwa wurare biyar bayan digo, kuma UMF yana nan yadda yake. Masu launi a rabo ko giram suna canjawa tare da kayan aiki; waɗanda ke a % na tushe suna nan yadda suke, domin kashi na tushe ɗaya ne a kowane ma'auni.

compare.heading: Kwatanta girke-girke biyu
compare.text: Kwatanta, a gefen Ajiye ko a kan girke-girken da aka ajiye, yana jera UMF biyu oxide da oxide, tare da canjin daga na farko zuwa na biyu. Don kwatanta abu da irinsa, ƙidaya masu launi a cikin duka biyun ko a cikin babu ko ɗaya.
compare.modern: Girke-girken da ke amfani da kayan da ba a ƙara yinsa, kamar Custer Spar, yana faɗin abin da ake amfani da shi yanzu, da ko zai iya maye gurbinsa giram da giram. Gwada kayan zamani kuma ku kwatanta yana musanya su, ɗaya da ɗaya, a matsayin sabon girke-girke, kuma yana kwatanta shi da tsohon; Mayar da musanyar yana mayar da shi. Inda musanya ba ɗaya da ɗaya ba ne, Ba da shawarar adadi kuma ku kwatanta yana sake lissafa adadin don dawo da UMF, yana canja kaɗan gwargwadon iko. Idan sabon kayan ba zai iya dawo da wani abu da tsohon ya bayar ba, kamar potash na niter, yana tambayar abin da ya kamata ya yi haka. Yana daidaita oxide bayan gasa ne kawai, don haka gwada ƙaramin batch da farko.
compare.lead: Girke-girken da ke da darma (lead, Pb) yana faɗin haka. Maye gurbin darma yana tambayar cone da kuke gasawa har zuwa shi da frit babu darma da za a gina a kai, sannan ko dai ya sake gina glaze (an riƙe silica da alumina ɗinsa, tare da boron da wasu flux suna yin aikin darma) ko ya riƙe masu launinsa a kan tushe babu darma na frit da kaolin, 85 zuwa 15. Ana jera kaya masu darma don ƙarawa ne kawai idan darma a kunne take a ƙarƙashin Saituna a shafin asusunku.
compare.shelf: Daidaita da abin da nake da shi yana sake yin girke-girken daga kayan da kuke da su a hannu kawai, kusa da oxide ɗinsa bayan gasa gwargwadon yadda suka bari. Ana ajiye jerin kayanku da ke hannu tare da asusunku.
compare.tries: Kowanne daga cikin waɗannan zai iya ɗaukar kayan da za a gwada, duk waɗanda kuke da su ko kuke son a duba, kuma ku yi alama a Dole a yi amfani don riƙe ɗaya a ciki. Sabon girke-girken yana faɗin abin da kowane kaya ke bayarwa da ko daidaitawar tana buƙatarsa, abin da kuma zai taimaka, da abin da za a lura da shi. Idan ya wuce iyakar da aka ba da shawara, kamar boron mai yawa a cone 6 ko ɗanyen whiting a cone 04, yana faɗin abin da glaze zai iya yi maimakon ya ƙi. Maɓallansa suna sake lissafa girke-girken daga tsohon: bar wani kaya, ƙara ɗaya, ko ba da izinin ƙari fiye da iyaka.

numbers.heading: Karanta analysis da iyakoki
numbers.analysis: Analysis da iyakoki, a ƙarƙashin girke-girken, yana nuna mole na kowane oxide, mole % da nauyi % bayan gasa, LOI (raguwar nauyi a wuta) da faɗaɗawa saboda zafi da aka lissafa, ƙiyasi don kwatanta glaze.
numbers.limits: Iyakoki yana auna UMF da saitin iyakoki: iyakokin glaze mai ƙarfi na Hesselberth & Roy sai dai idan kun zaɓi na Glazecalc (ana ajiye zaɓin tare da saitunanku). Yana duba rukunin gasa da Gasa na girke-girken ke bayarwa: cone ɗinsa, ko iyakarsa. Iyakar da ta ratsa rukunoni, kamar cone 6 zuwa 10, tana nuna binciken rukunoni biyu gefe da gefe. Don duba rukuni ɗaya kawai, zaɓe shi a akwatin Gasa na iyakokin, wanda ke rinjayar gasar girke-girken kuma ana ajiye shi tare da girke-girken. Lambobin Hesselberth & Roy na cone 6 da cone 10 ne, don haka a ƙarancin zafi yana faɗin ba su shafa ba. Jagora ne, ba nasara ko faɗuwa ba. A sama, layi ɗaya yana kwatanta boron, silica da alumina na glaze da gasarsa, ta dokar boron ta Katz da lambobin Hesselberth & Roy ko wane saitin iyakoki kuka zaɓa: yana ba da bayani ne kawai idan sun yarda cewa glaze yana kama da na wata gasa daban, yana faɗin lokacin da ba zai iya yin hukunci ba (darma, lithium, raku da makamantansu), kuma jagora ne, ba gwaji ba.
numbers.stull: Taswirar Stull tana zana silica na glaze a kan alumina ɗinsa, tare da yankunan Stull na marar sheƙi, ɗan marar sheƙi da mai haske da kewayon saitin iyakoki. Jagora ce ga fuskar glaze, ba hasashe ba.
numbers.slurry: SG da ruwa yana amfani da dabarar Brongniart: auna nauyin wani adadin glaze da aka auna girmansa, sannan ku ga busasshen glaze a cikin bokiti, ruwan da zai kai shi SG da kuke so, ko ruwan sabon batch. Yawan nauyi yana bin saitinku na SG, Baumé ko nauyin pint.

print.heading: Buga shi don ɗakin glaze
print.text: Buga, a gefen Ajiye ko a kan girke-girken da aka ajiye, yana tsara shi don takarda. Buga dukan girke-girken tare da UMF da analysis ɗinsa, ko jerin batch kawai: abin da za a auna don batch na kowane girma, jimla mai gudana don aunawa cikin bokiti ɗaya, da akwatunan yin alama. Nauyi yana a giram, zuwa ɗaya cikin goma ko cikakke, ko a fam da oza: zaɓi a ƙarƙashin Saituna a shafin asusunku.

help.tips: Shawarwari: ana iya ƙara kayan da ba ya cikin jerin asali a shafin Kayan aiki daga tsarin sinadaransa ko analysis na mai sayarwa. Kuma ku gwada kafin ku amince: lambobin suna nuna yanayi, ba abin da kiln ɗinku zai yi ba.

checks.boronShortEffects: Zai iya kasa narkewa sosai, ya fito da tauri, bushe ko da ƙananan ramuka. Gwada shi; idan ba a gasa shi isasshe ba, gasa mai zafi fiye ko ɗan ƙarin frit na tushe yana taimakawa.

checks.aluminaLowProbably: Mai yiwuwa zai zama glaze mai sheƙi da ke gudana, zai iya yin crystal ko gajimare yayin hucewa, kuma ya fi laushi da rashin ɗorewa.

checks.aluminaHigh: Akwai alumina mai yawa idan aka kwatanta da silica (silica da alumina {ratio}:1).
checks.aluminaHighEffects: Zai iya kasa narkewa sosai kuma zai iya fitowa bushe ko marar sheƙi, da ƙananan ramuka ko wurare babu glaze.

checks.alkaliTends: Amma yakan yi crazing, wani lokaci bayan makonni, kuma yana da fuska mai laushi da za ta iya zubar ƙarfe: yana da kyau ga kayan ado, ba ga fuskokin abinci ba.

checks.whitingTends: A {percent}% yakan yi ƙananan ramuka ko kumfa kuma ya fito bushe, marar sheƙi ko kamar alli.

checks.clayNone: Wannan ba shi da ɗanyen yumɓu.
checks.clayLowFix: Ba tare da yumɓu ba glaze yana zama da tauri a ƙasan bokiti kuma yana zubewa kamar ƙura daga tukunya kafin gasa. Ƙara 1-2% bentonite don riƙe shi a cikin ruwa, ko ku riƙe ɗan yumɓu ku yarda da daidaitawa da ta ɗan bambanta.

checks.clayHighProbably: Mai yiwuwa zai tsage a kan tukunya kuma ya yi crawling zuwa wurare babu glaze a cikin kiln.
checks.clayHighTends: Yakan tsage a kan tukunya kuma ya yi crawling zuwa wurare babu glaze a cikin kiln.
checks.clayHighFix: Musanya wani ɓangarensa da calcined kaolin (kusan 12% ƙasa da nauyi), kuna riƙe kusan 15-20% ɗanye don glaze ya ci gaba da kasancewa a cikin ruwa.
checks.soluble: {name} yana narkewa a ruwa, wanda ke sa shi zama kayan glaze mara kyau: yana shiga cikin tukunya kuma yana canjawa yayin da glaze ke tsaye. Frit suna ɗauke da oxide iri ɗaya ba tare da narkewa ba.
checks.boronFrit: Frit na calcium borate yawanci ƙaramin ƙarin boron ne, ba tushe ba (wani mai sayarwa ya ce kada ya wuce 10%). A matsayin babban frit, ku sa ran glaze mai gudana da zai iya komawa kamar madara ko fari-shuɗi kuma ya yi crystal a cikin bokiti. Yi amfani da frit na tushe na borosilicate kuma ku riƙe wannan kaɗan.
checks.lowExpansionFrit: Frit masu ƙarancin faɗaɗawa maganin crazing ne, ana amfani da su kusan 5-10%. A matsayin babban frit glaze zai iya kasa narkewa sosai a cone 06-02 kuma ya rasa sheƙi; inda ya narke, zai iya yin shivering, yana jefa ɓawon kaifi daga bakunan tukwane.
checks.alkaliFrit: Frit mai yawan alkali a matsayin babban flux yana ba da launi mai haske amma glaze mai laushi da gudana da ke yin crazing a kan kusan kowane yumɓu: yana da kyau don crackle da raku, ba ga fuskokin abinci ba.

worked.heading: Yadda ake lissafa UMF
worked.intro: UMF (tsarin Seger) yana ba da glaze a matsayin mole na kowane oxide, an daidaita shi ta yadda flux ɗinsa za su kai 1 gaba ɗaya. Ga matakan, tare da lambobin wannan girke-girke; Glazecalc yana lissafa nasa ta hanya ɗaya.
worked.gramsText: Karanta kowane adadi a matsayin giram na kayan. Kowane girman batch yana ba da UMF iri ɗaya, domin ana raba kowace lamba da jimlar flux a ƙarshe.
worked.molesHeading: Nemo mole na kowane oxide a cikin kowane kaya
worked.molesText: Analysis na kaya yana ba da kashin kowane oxide da yake bari bayan gasa. Giram ɗinsa × wannan kashi ÷ 100 su ne giram na oxide, kuma waɗannan giram ÷ molar mass na oxide (giram a cikin mole ɗaya nasa) su ne mole ɗinsa.

worked.totalsText: Haɗa mole na kowane oxide daga kowane kaya. Flux, waɗanda ke narkar da gilashin, su ne oxide na R₂O da RO, kamar soda, potash, lime da magnesia.

worked.answerText: Lambobi iri ɗaya yadda maginan tukwane ke karanta su: flux, masu daidaitawa da masu yin gilashi, tare da rabon silica da alumina.
worked.rounding: An tattara lambobin don nuna su, amma kowane mataki yana amfani da su ba a tattara ba, don haka haɗa lambobin da aka tattara zai iya ɗan bambanta a wuri na ƙarshe.

liner.note: Lafiyar abinci ta dogara da gasa wannan glaze zuwa cone ɗin da aka gwada shi a kai: glaze da ba a gasa isasshe ba zai iya zubar ƙarfe (leaching).
liner.range: An bayar da gasar wannan glaze a matsayin kewayo, don haka gwada shi a ƙarshen ƙasa na kewayon, inda ya fi ƙarancin narkewa.
liner.untested: Ba a yi wa wani cone alama a matsayin an gwada ba tukuna.
liner.test: Gwajin zubar ƙarfe (leach test) na tukwanenku da aka gasa ne kaɗai ke nuna ko yana da lafiya ga abinci.

help.cone: Cone ɗin da kuka gasa wannan glaze zuwa gare shi. Cone suna auna aikin zafi (lokaci da zafi), ba zafi kaɗai ba, don haka cone 06 ya fi sanyi sosai fiye da cone 6.
help.range: Idan yana aiki a cikin kewayo, ba da cone mafi ƙanƙanta da mafi girma, kuma ku yi alama a kan cone ɗin da kuka gasa shi zuwa gare su da gaske: cone ɗin da aka gwada yana fitowa da farko. Glaze zai iya bayyana, kuma ya yi aiki, daban a kowane ƙarshe.
help.convert: Ana riƙe cone yadda kuka ba da shi. Duk wani canji zuwa wani ma'auni ko zuwa zafi kusan-kusan ne: cone yana lanƙwasa a zafi daban a saurin hawan zafi daban, kuma cone na SK da na Orton masu lamba ɗaya ba ɗaya ba ne.
help.move: Mayar da glaze zuwa wani cone yawanci yana nufin sake tsara shi, ba kawai gasa shi da zafi fiye ko sanyi fiye ba. Kwafa don wani cone yana riƙe siga biyun.
